parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no facility or bathroom restriction, no documented police targeting of gender-nonconforming people, and no reported mistreatment of trans visitors at borders or in custody. Hate-speech and hate-crime provisions expressly cover gender identity (fine raised 2024; bias an aggravating factor), conversion practices are banned, and a self-determination recognition bill is pending. Conversely, enforcement of those protections is documented as inconsistent — clergy incitement and two capital attacks drew no police action — the dominant church is socially conservative, gender identity is absent from equal-treatment grounds, no anti-homophobia plan exists, and no LGR is in force. These resident-facing gaps and dated, LGB-flavoured incidents show friction and uneven recourse, not traveller-facing exposure; no universal-exposure measure or organised targeting is documented. One region recognises nonbinary identities, adding mild protection. Sits in the reduced-risk band.
